title: Echoes as Anchors: Probabilistic Costs and Attention Refocusing in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.06600v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work improves reasoning in large reasoning models (LRMs) by test-time scaling through self-consistency and parallel thinking, adding generic "thinking tokens", or presenting the question twice, as in re-reading (RE2). However, these approaches either inject task-agnostic tokens or mandate heuristics that do not explain, and often ignore, the spontaneous repetition that many LRMs exhibit at the head of their long chain-of-thought (CoT). In this work, we investigate the model's tendency to restate the question, which we dub Echo of Prompt (EOP), as a mechanism that shapes computation from the start and can be viewed as prompt repetition inside the reasoning trace rather than in the input. translated_title: 回声作为锚点：大语言模型推理中的概率代价与注意力重聚焦
translated_abstract: 近期工作通过测试时扩展来提升大型推理模型（LRMs）的推理能力，方法包括自一致性与并行思考、添加通用的“思考标记”，或者将问题呈现两次（如重读方法 RE2）。然而，这些方法要么注入与任务无关的标记，要么采用无法解释、且常常忽视许多大型推理模型在长思维链（CoT）开头所表现出的自发重复行为的启发式策略。在本工作中，我们研究了模型复述问题的倾向，并将其命名为“提示回声”，认为它是一种从一开始就塑造计算过程的机制，可以被视为发生在推理轨迹内部（而非输入中）的提示重复。我们通过将回声移除建模为拒绝采样，形式化了其概率代价，并定义了“回声似然差距”这一可计算的代理指标，将早期重复与似然增益及下游准确率联系起来。我们发现：（1）在因果干……
tldr: 该论文揭示并形式化了大型推理模型在思维链开头自发复述问题（“提示回声”EOP）的现象，证明这种以拒绝采样刻画的概率代价实际上起到了锚定注意力、提升似然与下游准确率的作用，并提出了可计算的“回声似然差距”作为预测指标。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the spontaneous restatement of the prompt at the start of a reasoning model's chain-of-thought ("Echo of Prompt") as an intrinsic anchoring mechanism—formalized via rejection sampling—that trades a probabilistic cost for attention refocusing and accuracy gains, with a computable "Echo Likelihood Gap" as its predictive proxy.
